war_slings.name: War Slings
war_slings.observation: A braided sling and a pouch of chosen river stones reach an enemy beyond the throw of any spear.

hide_wicker_shields.name: Hide and Wicker Shields
hide_wicker_shields.observation: Rawhide stretched over a wicker frame turns aside arrows and sling stones.

throwing_spears.name: Throwing Spears
throwing_spears.observation: Light spears thrown in a volley break a rush before it reaches the line.

stone_maceheads.name: Stone Mace Heads
stone_maceheads.observation: A drilled and polished stone on a stout haft is a weapon, and in a leader's hand a sign of rank.

ambush_raids.name: Ambush and Dawn Raids
ambush_raids.observation: Raiders lie up in the dark and strike at first light, before the camp is awake.
ambush_raids.social_consequence: Young men win names by the dawn raid; the neighbours remember, and answer in kind.

herd_recovery_pursuit.name: Herd Recovery Pursuit
herd_recovery_pursuit.observation: When the herd is driven off, the young men run the tracks at once and bring it back before it is scattered.

clay_sling_bullets.name: Clay Sling Bullets
clay_sling_bullets.observation: Fired clay bullets of one weight fly truer than river stones and can be made by the basketful.

raid_scouting.name: Raid Scouting
raid_scouting.observation: Scouts go a day ahead of the war party and come back with the lie of the land and the enemy's numbers.

thorn_barriers.name: Thorn Barriers
thorn_barriers.observation: A ring of cut thorn around the camp keeps out raiders at night and wolves from the herd.

weapon_free_gatherings.name: Weapon-free Gatherings
weapon_free_gatherings.observation: At the great gatherings spears are stacked at the edge of the ground, and quarrels wait for the elders.
weapon_free_gatherings.social_consequence: Feuding families can now meet, trade and marry at the gathering without blood.

hostage_exchange.name: Hostage Exchange
hostage_exchange.observation: Each side sends a son to live with the other as surety that the peace will hold.
hostage_exchange.social_consequence: The peace holds as long as the hostages are well treated, and some grow up with two peoples.

defensive_ditch_siting.ability_reason: A ditch on the right line makes a village hard to rush.

truce_sanctuary.name: Truce Seasons and Sanctuaries
truce_sanctuary.observation: In the holy months and at the sacred places, no blood may be shed, even between enemies.

ditch_palisades.name: Ditch Palisades
ditch_palisades.observation: A fence of sharpened stakes along the ditch bank turns a ditch into a wall.

barred_palisade_gates.name: Barred Palisade Gates
barred_palisade_gates.observation: The gaps in the palisade become gates, barred with a beam at dusk.

hilltop_refuges.name: Hilltop Refuges
hilltop_refuges.observation: A stone-walled enclosure on the hill above the village holds everyone and the herds when raiders or floods come.

cast_copper_weapons.name: Cast Copper Weapons
cast_copper_weapons.observation: Copper poured into stone moulds makes points and blades that hold an edge and can be recast when broken.

market_peacekeepers.name: Market Peacekeepers
market_peacekeepers.observation: Armed men chosen by the elders keep order at the market and the festival, and break up fights before they become feuds.

copper_maceheads.name: Copper Mace Heads
copper_maceheads.observation: A cast copper mace head, bright as fire, crushes what stone would glance from.
copper_maceheads.social_consequence: The copper mace marks the man who carries it; command begins to look like a thing one can hold.

copper_daggers.name: Copper Daggers
copper_daggers.observation: A cast copper dagger is worn at the belt by every man of standing.

gate_watchtowers.name: Gate Watchtowers
gate_watchtowers.observation: A timber tower beside the gate lets the watch see raiders a long way off and shoot down on them.

night_gate_challenge.name: Night Gate Challenge
night_gate_challenge.observation: The gate shuts at dusk; a stranger who comes after must give his name and be vouched for.
night_gate_challenge.social_consequence: Strangers now wait outside the gate until someone answers for them.

common_armory.name: Common Armory
common_armory.observation: Spears, shields and bows are kept in a common store and issued when the alarm is raised.
common_armory.social_consequence: Weapons belong to the store now, not the household; the keeper decides who is armed.

household_muster.name: Household Muster
household_muster.observation: Each household sends its able fighters when called, and the elders keep the count of who owes how many.

shield_wall.ability_reason: A locked shield line lets ordinary villagers stand against a charge.

wall_missile_posts.name: Manned Wall Posts
wall_missile_posts.observation: Archers and slingers stand on the wall at fixed posts, each covering the ground below its stretch.
wall_missile_posts.ability_reason: A manned wall turns every raid into a costly assault.

flanked_gate_complex.name: Flanked Gate Complex
flanked_gate_complex.observation: Towers either side of a gate passage catch attackers in a crossfire before they reach the doors.

copper_battle_axes.name: Copper Battle-axes
copper_battle_axes.observation: A shaft-hole axe cast in copper splits shields that spears only scratch.

palace_guard.name: Palace Guard
palace_guard.observation: Armed retainers of the ruler's household guard the palace, the stores and the ruler's person.
palace_guard.social_consequence: The ruler's retainers answer to the house, not the village; people feel both safer and watched.

battle_wagons.name: Battle Wagons
battle_wagons.observation: Heavy four-wheeled wagons drawn by onager crosses carry a driver and a javelin man into the enemy line.

copper_helmets.name: Copper Helmets
copper_helmets.observation: Beaten copper helmets and cloaks studded with metal discs save the front rank from glancing blows.

deep_phalanx.name: Deep Phalanx
deep_phalanx.observation: Ranks many deep, with long spears and body-length shields, push forward as one block.

scaling_ladders_rams.name: Ladders and Battering Beams
scaling_ladders_rams.observation: Ladders against the wall and a beam swung at the gate let an army take a town it cannot starve.

standing_paid_company.name: Standing Paid Company
standing_paid_company.observation: A company of fighters is fed and armed by the ruler all year and trains instead of farming.
standing_paid_company.ability_reason: A year-round company is ready the day trouble comes.
standing_paid_company.social_consequence: Men who fight for the ruler's grain owe nothing to their fathers' fields; the village loses sons and gains a garrison.

socketed_spearheads.name: Socketed Spearheads
socketed_spearheads.observation: A bronze spearhead cast with a socket slides onto the shaft and stays there through the fight.

composite_bow.name: Composite Bow
composite_bow.observation: Horn, wood and sinew glued in layers make a short bow that shoots farther than any tall self bow.
composite_bow.ability_reason: The composite bow outranges every older bow.

sentry_watchwords.name: Sentry Watchwords
sentry_watchwords.observation: A word changed each night lets sentries tell a friend from a stranger in the dark.

siege_ramps_mining.name: Siege Ramps and Mining
siege_ramps_mining.observation: Earth ramps raised against the wall and tunnels dug beneath it bring down defenses that ladders cannot.

war_chariots.name: Light War Chariots
war_chariots.observation: Light two-wheeled cars behind trained horses carry an archer across open ground faster than any runner.
war_chariots.ability_reason: Chariots give a ruler striking speed and a new warrior elite.

shield_equipment_fitting.observation: Shields are shaped and strapped for the man who carries them, whether he stands in the line or rides the chariot.

border_fortress_chains.name: Border Fortress Chain
border_fortress_chains.observation: Forts a signal's distance apart along the frontier pass warning by fire and smoke faster than raiders can ride.

sickle_sword.name: Sickle-sword
sickle_sword.observation: A curved bronze blade hooks a shield aside and cuts over it.

chariot_crews.name: Chariot Crews
chariot_crews.observation: Driver and archer train together for years until the car turns and the arrow flies as one.

glacis_ramparts.name: Glacis Ramparts
glacis_ramparts.observation: A steep smooth bank of packed earth before the wall keeps rams and ladders off its foot.

written_patrol_reports.name: Written Patrol Reports
written_patrol_reports.observation: Border patrols send a tablet each day: who crossed, how many, and which way they went.

allied_contingents.name: Allied and Hired Contingents
allied_contingents.observation: Allies and hired bands march with our army under their own leaders.
allied_contingents.social_consequence: Foreign fighters march under our banner for pay or oath; they must be fed, and watched.

casemate_walls.name: Casemate Walls
casemate_walls.observation: Two parallel walls tied by cross-walls, their rooms used as stores, stand thick against rams.

bronze_rapiers.name: Bronze Rapiers
bronze_rapiers.observation: Long, narrow bronze blades reach past a shield rim to thrust.

scale_armor_attachment.observation: Bronze scales sewn onto leather let a chariot crew take arrows that would have killed them.

art_proposals.note: Existing paintings proposed for NEW items once the Phase 1 art test allows them; not read by the loader.
